definitions.label: 目标达成
definitions.description: goal property holds on the final truth state
definitions.observable: the scenario's goal property on the environment's truth state

definitions.label: 被拒动作
definitions.observable: outcomes the environment returned as REJECTED

definitions.label: 效果差异
definitions.description: steps whose observed effect differed from the model's expectation
definitions.observable: steps whose observed effects differed from the model's prediction

definitions.label: Tokens
definitions.observable: input + output tokens as reported by the provider (unreported calls not counted)

definitions.label: CAGE 原生蓝方奖励
definitions.description: NATIVE: CybORG's own blue-team reward summed over the episode
definitions.window: whole episode (world steps 1..end), from the referee timeline

definitions.label: 正常业务成功率
definitions.description: green work / service-access actions reported TRUE among TRUE + FALSE
definitions.observable: each green agent's last action and its observation `success`
definitions.window: whole episode (world steps 1..end), from the referee timeline

definitions.label: 正常业务失败次数
definitions.observable: green work / access actions reported FALSE
definitions.window: whole episode (world steps 1..end), from the referee timeline

definitions.label: 结束时红方立足主机
definitions.observable: hosts with a red session in CybORG's state (referee)

definitions.label: 红方立足主机·步
definitions.observable: Σ over world steps of hosts with a red session (referee)
definitions.window: whole episode (world steps 1..end), from the referee timeline

definitions.label: 恢复时间
definitions.description: mean steps from a host gaining a red session to losing all of them; MISSING when no host recovered
definitions.observable: enter / leave events of the red foothold set per host (referee)
definitions.window: whole episode (world steps 1..end), from the referee timeline

definitions.label: 未恢复主机
definitions.observable: hosts in the foothold set at the end

definitions.label: 蓝方代理数量（不是业务存活）
definitions.description: a count of platform-controlled blue agents; it is not a business metric
